titulo: B1 review and mock test: What you can do at B1

aula.objetivo: Take an honest stock of your level, practice reading, listening, writing and speaking in the B1 format and take an original mock test.

sessao.titulo: What you can do at B1

blocos.titulo: An honest list of what you can do at B1
blocos.explicacao: Read each line and answer honestly: I do it easily, I do it with effort, or I cannot do it yet. For whatever you cannot do yet, go back to the indicated lesson. This list is a Linvuu study tool, not an official assessment.

tabela.rule: start, keep going and end a conversation about familiar topics; give an opinion and agree or disagree politely.
narrate a past event, a film or a book, with sequence and cause.
talk about the future, about conditions and about unreal situations in the present and in the past.
manage while traveling, complain politely and ask for a refund.
write formal emails, take part in simple meetings, talk about your résumé and interview.
understand the gist of clear texts and conversations on everyday topics; use context and cognates.
write simple, cohesive texts with connectors on familiar topics.
ask for repetition, describe with other words and confirm what you understood.

blocos.enunciado: For each line in the list, speak for 30 seconds in French about a real example from your life.
Reread aloud the two B1 maps from lesson 61 and mark the topics where you still hesitate.
